_doc: The clip representation each mob pack bakes, read by tools/layout.mjs, readPackFormats: matrices (per-bone rigid matrices, tools/mobs.mjs, exportMob) or pose (tools/actorBake.mjs, bakeActor). A row of models/mobs.json takes its pack's representation; a row's own format must agree with it. The bestiary keeps matrices until its rows move to pose, when this file goes.
